comment: Soul Analysis authored copy (Compass §3 Layer C, §4.7). Client-side only. {A}/{B} are phrase-book phrases; {KEY} is the question's display name. Ω comparisons acknowledge absence without explaining the method (OD-6).
intro:
COMPARATIVE ESCHATOLOGY — two souls, one desk.
The Ledger counts deeds, not people. So shall we.
solo_intro: SOUL ANALYSIS — one soul, read closely.
missing_one: Only one soul met {KEY} — they {A}. The other was already elsewhere.
omega_compare: One of these souls left almost no footprints. The Ledger records that they left. It does not record a path, because there wasn't one. The comparison, accordingly, is brief: everything the first soul did, the second soul declined — including this analysis, probably.
omega_solo: This soul left almost no footprints. The Ledger records that they left. It does not record a path, because there wasn't one.
joke: The Department notes that both souls used the same door to get in. It always impresses the Department, how many ways there are to leave.
question: CARRIED FORWARD, JOINTLY: which of these two paths would you defend to the other — and would you still, after hearing them defend theirs?
error: This code is from another underworld, or from no underworld at all. The desk returns it, apologetically.
